title: feat(scripts): add a Copilot review wave and severity audit helper
body:
<!-- idd-skill-authoring-publication: target=target-a223b37ee8a1a3a9; anchor=kurone-kito/idd-skill#3221; set=set-1792e4773b15c426; session=claude-urgency-3364151bfe0a; token=pub-f4f1f09b2c26b39e -->

## Background

Changes that aimed to cut Copilot review cost have shipped without a
repeatable way to measure their effect. PR `#3046` (lowering
`critiqueLoop.deferAfterRounds` to `5`) merged with no acceptance
criterion, and a later manual audit (2026-09-21, 64 merged PRs) had to
rebuild the numbers by hand before it could conclude the cutoff had
never fired. The 2026-09-24 baseline for the adopt-now urgency defer
rule (the sibling track in this roadmap) was again assembled with
throwaway scripts: 60 merged PRs `#3089`-`#3210`, 192 Copilot reviews
(136 `ccr-overview-v2`); Open-section finding appearances High 70 /
Medium 66 / Low 67 (a carried-over finding counts once per review that
lists it); unique finding threads High 49 / Medium 37 / Low 39;
Copilot-Low thread dispositions Accepted 36 / Rejected 0 / no reply 3;
and 11/11 reviews whose open findings were all Low followed by another
review.

Copilot's severity label is only machine-readable from the
`<!-- ccr-overview-v2 -->` overview review body. Findings are grouped
under `<details>` summaries `Open (<n>)` and
`Resolved since last review (<n>)`, where each line carries
`alt="<High|Medium|Low> severity"` image text and a `#discussion_r<id>`
link to its inline comment, with a `· New` suffix on findings new in
that review. A third group, "Previously missed", also carries severities
but no `#discussion_r<id>` link: those findings are not inline threads.
Each one is a nested `<details>` whose `<summary>` carries the severity
image and whose body cites a file and line (see PR `#3147`, review
5255592914). The window holds 41 such appearances (Low 29, Medium 12). The body can also
contain a "What changed in this PR" section, and the header can say
`Findings: None` while "Previously missed" still lists items. Inline
comment bodies and pre-v2 reviews carry no severity.

Maintainer decision (Groom hearing, 2026-09-24): implement this
measurement as a repository-local helper script tracked by its own
issue, and record the baseline so the adopt-now defer rule's effect can
be re-measured on demand.

## Proposed change

Add a repository-local helper `src/scripts/copilot-review-wave-audit.mts`
(generated to `scripts/copilot-review-wave-audit.mjs` by
`pnpm run build`). It is not distributed to `idd-template/`, like
`audit-code-span-wrap`.

- **Pure core** (exported, network-free, unit-tested). Given one PR's
  Copilot reviews (`copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]`, in submission
  order) and its review comments, compute:
  - review count, and v2 versus legacy count;
  - per v2 review, the Open findings with severity, `discussion_r` id,
    and new-versus-carried status, plus a separate per-severity count of
    "Previously missed" findings (thread-less, so excluded from every
    thread-keyed metric);
  - per unique finding thread (first severity seen per id), the
    disposition from the replies to that comment id, classified with
    the existing `DISPOSITION_*_PREFIX_RE` patterns in
    `src/scripts/protocol-helpers.mts`: `deferred` (a `**Rejected**`
    reply containing `deferred to follow-up issue`), `rejected` (another
    `**Rejected**` reply), `accepted` (`**Accepted**`), `other` (any other
    recognized disposition, such as `**Awaiting maintainer decision**`),
    or `none`;
  - a transition table keyed by the highest open severity of each v2
    review (`None`, `Low`, `Medium`, `High`), split into "followed by
    another Copilot review" and "last review".
- **Thin CLI**, modelled on `src/scripts/audit-pr-cleanup.mts` (which
  already has `--prs` and `--format`). `--prs <n,n,...>` or `--limit <N>`
  (most recent merged PRs), plus `--format json|tsv`. It fetches through `gh api` and merges
  paginated pages correctly: `gh api --paginate` with a per-page `--jq`
  prints one array per page, so never rely on it to merge pages. It
  prints per-PR rows and a cohort summary with the same metrics as the
  baseline above.
- A missing or changed overview format degrades gracefully: count the
  review as legacy or unparsed, never crash.
- Tests in `tests/copilot-review-wave-audit.test.mts` use fixture bodies
  modelled on real `ccr-overview-v2` reviews (Open with mixed
  severities, Resolved-only, "Previously missed" with a
  `Findings: None` header, no findings, legacy body) and reply chains
  that cover all five disposition outcomes.
- Register the helper where the repository's helper-inventory tests
  require it. Add it to `SOURCE_REPO_INTERNAL_ENTRY_PATHS` in
  `tests/helper-invocation-profile.test.mts` with a justification
  comment (precedent: `token-cost-harvest`, `idd-critique-report`),
  because that test scans `docs/**` for `node scripts/<x>.mjs`. Add it
  to `COVERED_HELPERS` in `tests/help-text-flags.test.mts` if it
  declares a flag spec. Commit the `.gitattributes` `linguist-generated`
  line that `pnpm run build` writes.
- Document the helper and the 2026-09-24 baseline, with the metric
  definitions above and the exact reproducing command, in a new section
  of `docs/critique-telemetry.md`. That doc already covers Copilot
  review cost. `docs/token-cost.md` is not suitable: its scope is agent
  token counts only, and it contains a generated region.

## Acceptance criteria

- `node scripts/copilot-review-wave-audit.mjs --help` documents the
  flags. The core function is exported and covered by
  `tests/copilot-review-wave-audit.test.mts` for severity parsing,
  new-versus-carried detection, "Previously missed" counting, all five
  disposition outcomes, the
  transition table, and legacy or unparsed bodies.
- Running the CLI with `--prs` over merged PRs `#3089`-`#3210`
  reproduces the baseline under the definitions above (192 reviews,
  136 v2; Open appearances High 70 / Medium 66 / Low 67; unique threads
  49 / 37 / 39; Low thread dispositions 36 accepted / 0 rejected /
  3 none; 11/11 all-Low reviews followed; 41 "Previously missed"), or
  the PR body explains each difference with its cause (for example, a
  reply edited after 2026-09-24).
- `docs/critique-telemetry.md` documents the command, the metric
  definitions, and the baseline.
- `tests/helper-invocation-profile.test.mts` and
  `tests/help-text-flags.test.mts` pass with the new helper
  registered.
- `pnpm run build:check` passes (the `.mjs` matches its `.mts` source)
  and the configured `pre-push-validate` command passes.

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/copilot-review-wave-audit.mts`
- `scripts/copilot-review-wave-audit.mjs`
- `tests/copilot-review-wave-audit.test.mts`
- `tests/helper-invocation-profile.test.mts`
- `tests/help-text-flags.test.mts`
- `.gitattributes`
- `docs/critique-telemetry.md`

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented. A self-contained
repository-local helper with a fixed, reproducible baseline to check
against._
